items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Dr. Jones called me. She said, "Arnett?" I said, "Yes, Dr. Jones."

ctx.x: My daughter went into a tangent. She was in the room studying for a test the next day. She didn't know what happened. She don't know when they took her mother out. All she knew, she come out and went in the bathroom and saw all this blood, said, "What happened?" I said, Mommy had a hemorrhage." She said, "Will Mommy be all right?" I said, "God knows I hope so."

And we had finished talking about five minutes. Dr. Jones called me. She said, "Arnett?" I said, "Yes, Dr. Jones." And the phone went dead. I knew it had happened. She waited for a while. She said, Elizabeth is dead." I couldn't say nothing.
When you had this blackout, it was due to coughing?
